g.title: FLIP
g.text: Before the switch: ↑O2 → ↓front VEGF → arrested growth
After the switch: ↑O2 → ↓vitreous VEGF → less NV → BETTER
but capped by the √ diffusion law (PaO2 ≈ 95 mmHg needed at PMA 35)

g.title: ASYM
g.text: Ocular effect ∝ dose / vitreous volume (1.1 mL)
Systemic risk ∝ dose / body weight (1 kg)
The preterm eye gets 1.8× the adult ocular concentration
while the preterm body gets 35× the adult dose per kg.
Efficacy is logarithmic in dose; toxicity is linear.

g.title: EXCHANGE
g.text: Lowering the SpO2 target (NeOProM, per 1000 infants):
≈ 7.7 deaths per unfavourable structural outcome avoided
